{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99')
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of rows with revenue == "999999.99": {internal_test_count}')

# Check if any of these are in completed orders
completed_internal_test = df[internal_test_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')]
print(f'Number of completed internal test orders: {len(completed_internal_test)}')

# Check the actual values of 'revenue' to confirm format
print(f'Unique revenue values (first 10): {df["revenue"].unique()[:10].tolist()}')"}
